title: Venezuela vowed not to ‘hand over’ its oil. Trump aims to grab a windfall.
summary_full: The deal cements the United States’ long-term dominance over Venezuela, which has become a neo-colony since the U.S. military’s capture of then-President Nicolás Maduro in January.
